mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are enjoying clear skies and a full moon at Verona City Hall. If you look toward the west southwest over Mount Horeb at 9:40 PM, you can catch a glimpse of the space station as it travels toward the southwest, remaining low on the horizon. The overnight low will be 70 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The city has two major updates. First, the Senior Center is rolling out their tri-shaw bike program, which requires a signed waiver. Second, the City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for students grades K through 12, with winning designs being used in the November 2026 election.

Today you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow is a big day for trivia lovers with events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, and the farmer's market returns to Hometown Junction Park this Wednesday.
Looking at the report from last Monday, a Verona drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's office in locating an individual who fled from a residence in the town of Springdale.
The flavor of the day at Culver's is Snickers Swirl. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you still have plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
